statement:
∀ (x y : ℝ),
  (Summable fun k => |x ^ k / ↑k !|) ∧
    ∑' (k : ℕ), (x + y) ^ k / ↑k ! = (∑' (k : ℕ), x ^ k / ↑k !) * ∑' (k : ℕ), y ^ k / ↑k ! ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun z => ∑' (k : ℕ), z ^ k / ↑k !) (∑' (k : ℕ), x ^ k / ↑k !) x

goal.text:
